title: Onde Morar Em SP
description: Scores every block of São Paulo for commute, safety, green cover, walkability and quiet streets. Commutes are routed in the browser over SPTrans buses, metro and CPTM trains, and a GitHub Action refreshes the data every week.

title: br-grama
description: An interactive map of how the Brazilian state works, with about 9,000 researched entities. Each one comes with its source, date and confidence level.

title: melhor para ler
description: Turns scanned book PDFs into PDFs you can read on a phone: it straightens pages, splits double pages, crops margins and reflows columns. Everything runs in the browser.

title: GeoSimples
description: Tool designed for creation of simple and standardized images of geometric figures, mainly aimed at educative content creation.

title: Snake Game 3D
description: This is a retro Snake Game actually in 3D, meaning you can move in the three directions of space. It's harder than you think. And there are a lot of customizations.

title: Férias
description: A vacation planner that knows Brazil's national, state and municipal holidays. Plans can be shared with a link.

title: Particles And Random Physics
description: Made as an education tool, this is a 3D environment, where you can interact with a particle system behaving in accordance with some random physics that comes with a short description.

title: justaskforit
description: A toy portfolio with no pages and no menus. You ask for something and Gemini designs a page for it on the spot, using only a few markdown files about me. The page comes out different every time, and not always good.
